screens.beats: Sarvam has INR, UPI and GST but releases numbers when the wallet empties and shows a negative balance in normal type. Bolna bills in USD and has unanswered refund complaints. Retell stops calls at zero balance. Vapi and ElevenLabs refuse billing actions to API keys. 0 of 5 cap spend by API key. VP adds runway, reservations, a bounded overdraft, number protection, a GST/TDS invoice path above the e-mandate cap, and refunds any time.

comparison.best_competitor: Retell (per-second product cost lines) / Bolna (30 s pulse, fee inside the 6 cents)
comparison.their_best: Retell bills per product per second with typed lines. Bolna publishes 3.5 + 0.5 + 2 cents with a 30 s pulse.
comparison.vp_better_how: All-in INR per connected second with no minimum and telephony included. VP absorbs carrier pulse rounding. No burst, setup, per-line or per-dial fees. At 30-90 s calls the effective price is 3.49 against Sarvam 5.07-7.40 and Bolna 5.72-7.63.
comparison.evidence: RET-34, RAP-36/51; BOL-33, WT bolna 34/35; SAR-38; research/2026-10-20/teardown/synthesis/economics.csv [C, no invoice read]

comparison.dimension: Price shown at the point of choice
comparison.best_competitor: Retell (price at the toggle) and Vapi (per-row latency and price with presets)

comparison.vp_better_how: Every stack row shows INR, India-measured p50/p90 with n and date, residency, data-use and sunset badges. The header shows all-in INR including telephony, pulse and turn wait, plus a predicted reply gap at the phone.

comparison.their_best: INR credits via Razorpay, GST split, UPI autopay, unanswered calls free.
comparison.vp_better_how: Adds an invoice/NEFT path above the INR 15,000 e-mandate cap, TDS credit by Form 16A, refunds any time to source, a bounded overdraft, numbers kept 30 days on an empty wallet, and red overdrawn states.

comparison.best_competitor: None adequate (Synthflow thresholds; Retell stop at zero)
comparison.their_best: Synthflow thresholds trigger invoices but do not cap. Retell's prepaid credits stop calls at zero.
comparison.vp_better_how: Caps per workspace, campaign and API key (daily and monthly). Reservation before dial. Stops at a call boundary, never cutting a live call. Caps settable by API.
comparison.evidence: research/2026-10-20/account-phase/SYNTHESIS.md XS-27/28 (0 of 5 cap by API key); SYN-10; RET-32

comparison.their_best: 8 typed USD cost lines per call and an /analytics query endpoint.
comparison.vp_better_how: Per-second INR lines that sum to the bill. Group by campaign, contact, agent, version, stack or day. Cost per earned outcome joined to payment or CRM events. Estimate vs actual tracked.
comparison.evidence: AP-35/37 (no group-by campaign or contact); data/blueprint/intelligence-module.json metric_layer

comparison.dimension: Price level vs the INR 2 ambition
comparison.their_best: Sarvam lists INR 3.00-3.50 on its own models. SquadStack quotes 2-5 per live minute, sales-led.
comparison.vp_better_how: Base INR 3.49 per second beats every published self-serve price on short calls. A pre-registered ladder drops the list to 2.99 / 2.49 / 1.99 as measured COGS falls, never by swapping the voice. Honest limit: not INR 2 at launch, and Sarvam Business is INR 0.09 cheaper on whole-minute calls.

comparison.best_competitor: Ultravox demo (p50 1.54 s, US-East) and ElevenLabs (3% collisions); India-hosted: Bolna (about 1.4 s code floor)
comparison.their_best: Fastest measured incumbent clean-turn p50 is 1.54 s. ElevenLabs talks over callers on only 3% of turns.
comparison.vp_better_how: India media and brain, warm pools, opening synthesised during the ring, leading-silence trim, per-segment budgets summing to 1.5 s at the handset, and a predicted gap shown per stack. Unproven: VP stacks still cut in on 15-42% of turns, and Natural is predicted at about 1.85-2.2 s.

comparison.best_competitor: Sarvam (Azure Central India runtime) and Bolna (AWS Mumbai)
comparison.their_best: The call is processed in India.
comparison.vp_better_how: India media and orchestration by default, an India-resident preset (Azure STT CI + gpt-4.1-mini SI + MAI-Voice CI), a residency badge on every stack row, and recordings and transcripts in Central India. No US session replay.
comparison.evidence: SAR-21/63, BOL-17/49; research/2026-10-20/teardown/SYNTHESIS.md §5 (4 of 8 US call paths)

comparison.best_competitor: Sarvam (published component uptime 99.94%) and Synthflow (incident.io write-ups)
comparison.their_best: A status page with components and uptime history.
comparison.vp_better_how: Synthetic Indian calls every 5 min per carrier and preset. Detect within 5 min, notify within 15. Speed counts as a status. Dual-carrier failover. Auto-resume without double dials. VP-cut calls are not billed and get a callback. 'Status unknown', never a false green.
comparison.evidence: SAR-19; SYN-52; VAP-54 (4 h 07 min, no campaign retry); RET-38/39 (6 h undetected); BOL-40 (9/18 upstream, no carrier failover); EXO-41; wt-vapi-37

comparison.best_competitor: Bolna (LLM overflow, provisioned to pay-as-you-go on 429)
comparison.vp_better_how: Health- and quota-checked routing at call start to a declared alternate stack, filed under the combination that ran. Mid-call, only a same-voice, same-model fallback. Carrier failover across two declared CLIs. Tests never fall back.

comparison.their_best: 109 operations with SDK and MCP from one spec, an idempotency key on calls, 422 on a PATCH to a published version, no hidden routes.
comparison.vp_better_how: One spec generates the API, SDKs, MCP, Operator tools and CLI, with a CI parity check against the dashboard. 422 on unknown fields. Idempotency on every create and dial. dry_run on every write. Billing, caps, imports and exports are on the API. MCP spend actions return approval links.

comparison.best_competitor: ElevenLabs (HMAC, auto-disable after 10 failures) and Sarvam (re-delivery up to 200 attempts)
comparison.their_best: Signed delivery with a failure guard, and integrator-friendly re-delivery.
comparison.vp_better_how: Slim signed events with a timestamp replay window, 72 h retries, a delivery log, replay by UI and API, and auto-disable only after 50 failures over 24 h, with notice. Delivery states are confirmed / not_executed / unknown.
comparison.evidence: research/2026-10-20/account-phase/elevenlabs report §4; SAR-18; AP-28..31 (Vapi full payloads, no retry by default); BOL-14 (unsigned)

comparison.best_competitor: Vapi (campaign.predial veto) and ElevenLabs (pre-call initiation webhook)
comparison.their_best: A blocking predial veto, and pre-call variables or overrides.
comparison.vp_better_how: Predial is fail-closed by default with a reason. Precall runs during the ring with an 800 ms budget and never delays the first word. Inbound pre-answer. A test button for each hook.

comparison.best_competitor: Retell (20 free, then USD 8 per slot)
comparison.their_best: A generous free concurrency floor with a reserved-for-batch readout.
comparison.vp_better_how: No per-line fee. Base 10, Plus 25, Premium 100. Raising is a card answered in minutes, capped only by provider quota.

comparison.best_competitor: Synthflow / Retell (CRM apps), Bolna (AiSensy WhatsApp node)
comparison.their_best: CRM write-back and a WhatsApp follow-up node.
comparison.vp_better_how: Payment webhooks as outcome sources (cost per renewal paid). Sheets two-way. The first partner's Indian CRM. WhatsApp utility with a per-message cost line. Each connector shows health and cost.
comparison.evidence: SYN-02, RET-59, BOL workflow nodes; data/blueprint/memory-omni-defaults.json connectors; docs/harvest/se-live.md

comparison.their_best: Fast changelogs (ElevenLabs 195 agent items in 6 months).
comparison.vp_better_how: Scout: 67 baselined URLs, daily and weekly diffs, tripwires mapped to W hypotheses, graph inbox entries, a market price index, and quarterly same-battery competitor calls.

Evidence that sets v3: COR §2 (D-lite reaches INR 2 from about 1.6M min/month); SY18 §4 (self-host from about 2.5M); research/2026-10-17/lanes/r2-untouched-raw/findings.md §2.1 (LIC RFP)

beyond: A speed-and-cost receipt on every call: per-segment milliseconds (endpoint, hold, brain, voice, phone) and per-second INR lines that sum exactly to the bill.
A predicted reply gap at the phone and an all-in INR at every stack choice, computed from an adapter registry that carries n, date and vantage. 0 of 6 dashboards predict a gap.
Spend caps on every API key, reservation before dial and a bounded overdraft. A live call is never cut for money, and numbers are never released inside 30 days.
The client pays per second while carriers bill VP in 30-60 s pulses. VP absorbs the rounding (about INR 0.03-0.07/min).
VP-fault calls are auto-credited with a reason; refunds of unused balance any time, to source, within 7 working days.
The pre-launch estimate becomes a tracked forecast, and its accuracy is shown to the client.
A public price ladder tied to measured cost: when VP's reconciled cost falls past a trigger, the list price falls. A cheaper voice can never trigger it.
A status page driven by synthetic Indian calls per carrier and preset, where 'speed degraded' is an incident and a dead monitor shows 'status unknown', never green.
Outage-aware campaigns: auto-resume without double dials, attempt budgets not charged for VP outages, and one callback for every answered call VP cut.
